{{Quote|According to this log, Operations Group One set out to free the Sith. Group Two stayed behind to secure their escape. Then they were attacked.|Commander Calum|<ref name="The Dread Masters" />}}
'''Special Operations Group Two''', more commonly known as '''Operations Group Two''', was one of five [[Operations Group|Special Operations Groups]] sent by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] into the [[Belsavis prison]] during the [[Galactic War]] in hopes of locating and freeing the [[Dread Masters]]. Operations Group Two was successful in breaching the section of the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as [[the Tomb]] with the aid of [[Special Operations Group One|Operations Group One]], and Group Two established a [[Imperial remote post|base camp]] while Group One continued into the Tomb&mdash;but the Imperials unleashed the savage [[Esh-kha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from their stasis; Group Two was completely wiped out, leaving their camp manned only by [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="The Dread Masters" />
